description: This file defines the TextNode class, representing a text node in the Twig templating engine. It includes methods for constructing and compiling the node to output PHP code that yields a string.

classes.name: TextNode
classes.description: A class representing a text node within the Twig templating engine, responsible for outputting static text when rendered.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TextNode with its data string and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the TextNode into PHP code that outputs the node's text data.
